learning_outcomes.text: Explain the regulation of broker-dealers and their agents under state law
Explain the regulation of investment advisers and their representatives under state law
Describe the regulation of securities and issuers, including registration and exemptions
Apply ethical practices, fiduciary obligations and prohibited conduct under the Uniform Securities Act
